name: CreateDesk
shortDescription: Content pipeline: editorial states, role rights, version history, scheduling and link allowlist.
features: Role rights: authors submit, reviewers approve, editors publish (enforced)
Pre-publish validation gates (length, placeholder text, date format)
External links checked against a configured allowlist (flagged, not silently published)
Version history with per-change diffs; editorial calendar; transition audit log
knownLimitations: Demo workspace simulated; no real CMS integrations
Scheduling stores timestamps only (no background publisher)
